scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "uvicorn --app-dir server app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4000" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && python3 -m compileall -q server/app
scripts.format: prettier --write "client/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "client/*.json" package.json README.md docs/superpowers/specs/*.md docs/superpowers/plans/*.md docker-compose.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "client/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "client/*.json" package.json README.md docs/superpowers/specs/*.md docs/superpowers/plans/*.md docker-compose.yml
